usageNotes: Creates a new cluster-level firewall IPSet, which is a named group of IP addresses or CIDRs that can be referenced by alias in firewall rules. Requires the `Sys.Modify` privilege on the root path. To rename an existing IPSet or update its comment without deleting it, pass the current name in `rename` and the new name (or same name) in `name`.

examples.summary: Create a new IPSet for trusted management hosts

params.name: mgmt-hosts
params.comment: Trusted management workstations and jump hosts

tips: IPSet names must start with a letter and may only contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (pattern: [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+).
Creating the IPSet is just the container — add individual IP/CIDR entries afterward using the POST /cluster/firewall/ipset/{name} endpoint.
Use the `digest` param to guard against concurrent modifications when scripting bulk changes.
The `rename` field doubles as an in-place update: set rename=<oldName> and name=<newName> to rename, or rename=name=<sameName> to update only the comment.
